Instructions for Use
Device description: The Zephyr Spinal System is a spinal fixation system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla): maximum B1+rms of 1 microtesla; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode; Any transmit coil may be used.
Image artifact: up to 3 mm.
